method: Author manually inspected the eight required command invocations and corresponding successful subprocess receipts, then checked each saved collection artifact against its original frozen reference. Private trace hashes bind the inspected records.
limitations: Corroborated trace, receipt and artifact evidence for frozen-bundle handoffs, not formal execution attestation or live browser orchestration. The publisher's generic collector matcher is textual command recognition and returned-observation presence alone does not establish subprocess success.
